svg.title: Alisier — an illustrative whitebeam form
svg.desc: An illustrative twig for the historical alisier group, shown in a whitebeam-like form rather than identified to one exact species. Alternate simple oval leaves have fine double teeth and closely parallel side veins. One turned leaf reveals its silvery felted underside. A branching cluster of small orange and rust red pomes bears persistent five-pointed calyx stars, above an engraved brown twig.
